source_text: Ascendit Bersabee; Dominus: noli timere. Altare et invocatio nominis. Tentorium.
pass_a_gloss: Went-up Beersheba; Lord: do-not fear. Altar and calling of-name. Tent.
pass_b_english: He goes up to Beersheba; [[the Lord: Do not fear >> Bible:Genesis 26:24]]. Altar and calling on the Name. The tent pitched.
